primary.source: snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 5 table row 'No. 121 3D Menu', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x9C, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 156 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 5 table row 'No. 122 3D Sync Invert', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x9D, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 157 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 5 table row 'No. 100 Back', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x85, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 133 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Goes back to previous OSD menu. Exits and saves menu settings.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 22 Brightness', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x16, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 22 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Displays the BRIGHTNESS setting bar.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 6 table row 'No. 136 Cinema Master', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0xBE, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 190 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Open / close CinemaMaster Menu

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 6 table row 'No. 137 Color Manage.', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x5B, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 91 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Open/Close "Color Management" Menu (display time based on "menu display time" setting)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 4 table row 'No. 72 COLOR TEMP', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x5F, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 95 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 17 Contrast', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x11, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 17 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Displays the CONTRAST setting bar.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 1 table row 'No. 12 Down', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x0C, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 12 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: When there is no OSD menu, press this button to enter Keystone menu, and press again to adjust the screen downward. When there is OSD menu on the screen, this button will move the chooser item to the next one.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 1 table row 'No. 7 Eco Blank', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x07, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 7 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: This button will turn projector into/out of blank mode.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 21 Enter/OK', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x15, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 21 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Enter key for OSD menu. For MHL RCP mode, it means Select function

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 4 table row 'No. 71 GAMMA', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x5E, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 94 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 6 table row 'No. 139 HDR', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x3C, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 60 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 4 table row 'No. 92 IRIS', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x7C, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 124 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Displays the setting bar for the adjustment of the motorised aperture lens IRIS.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 6 table row 'No. 138 keystone', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x2A, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 42 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 1 table row 'No. 13 Left', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x0D, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 13 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: When there is OSD menu on screen, this button will move the chooser item to the left one. When there is no OSD menu, press this key to show an adjusting bar at the bottom center of the screen, and press again to reduce the volume gradually.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 15 Menu', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x0F, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 15 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: This button will turn on/off OSD menu.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 16 Mode', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x10, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 16 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: The button will change picture mode.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 3 table row 'No. 62 Power Off', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x4E, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 78 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Turns off the projector.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 4 table row 'No. 63 Power On', read by eye from the page's picture (code Ox4F, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 79 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: Turns on the projector.; the sheet writes the code 'Ox4F' with a letter O, read as 0x4F

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 2 table row 'No. 14 Right', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x0E, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 14 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: This button will move the chooser item to the right one. When there is no OSD menu, press this key to show an adjusting bar at the bottom center of the screen, and press again to increase the volume gradually.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 5 table row 'No. 94 SHARP', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x7E, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 126 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says)

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 3 table row 'No. 43 Smart Eco Light Mode', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x30, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 48 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: By pressing “Smart Eco” button, could open “Quick Lamp Menu” to select lamp mode. Light Mode

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 1 table row 'No. 4 Source', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x04, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 4 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: This button will show available source options.

snapav.com BenQ IR code sheet/HT5550_IR_Codes.pdf@085666ea (retrieved 2026-11-13) page 1 table row 'No. 11 Up', read by eye from the page's picture (code 0x0B, Support Yes): NEC1 device 0 subdevice 48 function 11 (custom code 0x0030, 38 kHz, as the sheet's format table says); the sheet describes it: When there is no OSD menu, press this button to enter Keystone menu, and press again to adjust the screen upward. When there is OSD menu on screen, this button will move the chooser item to the upper one.
